decision.reasoning_trace: I was looking for a standard, high-quality daily-use or laptop backpack. While the Gelindo hydration pack and the W WINTMING tactical bag have good ratings, they are too specialized for my needs. Much of the product feed was cluttered with non-backpack items like camping pots, sleeping pads, and trekking poles. The few standard backpacks available, such as the FOCO NFL bag or the vimapo foldable option, didn't feel like the right balance of durability and features compared to what I expected. I will continue my search elsewhere to find a better general-purpose backpack.
